draft.shortGloss: to pay; to shop for groceries
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and routine, focused on the transaction at hand
notes: Used for paying money (e.g., จ่ายเงิน 'pay money', จ่ายค่าอาหาร 'pay for food'). For spending time, use ใช้.
Commonly used in จ่ายตลาด ('to do the grocery shopping at a market').

senses.definition: To give money in exchange for goods, services, or bills.

examples.translation: I have to pay for the food.
examples.emotion: slightly burdened by the necessity of the payment

senses.definition: To buy food and household goods, especially at a market.

examples.text: แม่ไปจ่ายตลาดทุกเช้า
examples.translation: Mom goes grocery shopping at the market every morning.

faults.why: Handing out papers in class is แจก, not จ่าย; จ่าย is for disbursing money/supplies.

faults.why: Dispensing items (like medicine) is narrow; everyday shopping (จ่ายตลาด) is much more useful.
